evidence: decorative_mascot: Data hovers in the same mid-right slot over the bars from hook@0.3 to seg2:end doing nothing tied to the stat; at seg3:start/seg3:mid he only spins a hoop and at payoff@-1.8 he is cropped to legs behind the speech bubble — no setup->action->payoff at any beat.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg4:start the yellow callout 'The land shrank. Somehow the grain didn't.' covers the chart title and the entire 1972 row, and at payoff@-1.8 and seg4:end the mascot is sliced to two legs and a sleeve behind the bubble's top edge; meanwhile the bars underneath still climb to their maximum at 2014 (724,692,671), so the visible chart says land GREW while the payoff line says it shrank — the 415,702,088 collapse the title promises is never drawn as a bar.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The closing callout is composited at fixed top-center over the still-running bar race instead of being staged after a final beat, and the cereal series was truncated at 2014 so the 2024 drop has no bar to animate down to.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Stage the payoff as its own beat: let the 2014 bar visibly retract to the 2024 value of 415,702,088 hectares below the 1972 bar, move the callout into the cleared lower-right space so the title and 1972 row stay visible, and give Data a physical action on that shrink (he rides the bar end down and lands) so the words, the chart, and the mascot agree.
